description: This file contains the implementation of FactoryRuntimeLoader class which lazily loads runtime implementations for Twig components by mapping class names to callable factories.

classes.name: TwiguntimeLoader actoryRuntimeLoader
classes.description: A class that implements RuntimeLoaderInterface to load runtime objects lazily based on a class-to-factory map.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the map of class names to factory callables.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and returns the runtime object by class name, using the mapped factory callable, or returns null if not found.
